note: Prompt B-C pinned allowlist for verify_execution_path_gate.py. A live toolchain-fetch token in an execution path MUST be pinned here with a receipt (Prompt B-D: source / revision / reason / owner_approval / destination). Pins are classified: approved-ci-toolchain (the CI runner provisions its own pinned toolchain -- not a repo execution path that an agent-miss triggers), guard-definition (a verifier's forbidden-token table, data not execution), test-fixture (a test asserting guard detection), prose-documentation (a user-facing / inventory string that mentions a toolchain). No pin may cover a real agent/CLI path that would download/clone/install a second toolchain on a locator miss. A pin that matches no live hit is STALE and fails the gate.
